summary: Instance groups and container groups can cap max_concurrent_jobs and max_forks, for example 10 jobs and 50 forks per organization; extra jobs wait or go to another group with capacity, and task_impact is counted against max_forks.
questions: How do I limit concurrent jobs on an instance group?
What is max_forks on an instance group?
Limit the number of forks an organization can use
Why does my job wait even though the instance group has capacity?

answer_card.title: Cap jobs and forks on an instance group
answer_card.answer_md:
Set these on the instance group (or container group):

```
max_concurrent_jobs: 10
max_forks: 50
```

- With 10 jobs of 5 forks running, an 11th job waits (or runs on another group with capacity).
- With 2 jobs of 20 forks running, a job with `task_impact` of 11 or more waits.
